title: At the Café
summary: Ana orders breakfast at a Rio café. Practises greetings, ordering, and simple present-tense verbs.

lines.speaker: Dona Lúcia
lines.pt: Bom dia, Ana! Chegou cedo hoje.
lines.en: Good morning, Ana! You arrived early today.

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.pt: Bom dia, Dona Lúcia! Hoje tenho aula às oito.
lines.en: Good morning, Dona Lúcia! Today I have class at eight.

lines.speaker: Dona Lúcia
lines.pt: Então vamos fazer um café rápido. O que você vai querer?
lines.en: Then let's make a quick coffee. What would you like?
lines.note: 'vai querer' is the normal polite way to take an order.

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.pt: Eu quero um café com leite e um pão de queijo, por favor.
lines.en: I want a coffee with milk and a cheese bread, please.

lines.speaker: Dona Lúcia
lines.pt: O pão de queijo acabou de sair do forno.
lines.en: The cheese bread just came out of the oven.

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.pt: Que bom! Ele está com um cheiro ótimo.

lines.speaker: Dona Lúcia
lines.pt: Mais alguma coisa? Um suco pequeno?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.en: That's all. How much is it?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.pt: Aqui está. Obrigada pelo café de sempre!
lines.en: Here you go. Thanks for the usual coffee!

lines.speaker: Dona Lúcia
lines.pt: De nada, querida. Boa aula e bom apetite!
lines.en: You're welcome, dear. Have a good class and enjoy your meal!

comprehension.question: What does Ana order?
options: Coffee with milk and cheese bread
comprehension.answer: Coffee with milk and cheese bread
comprehension.explanation: She says 'um café com leite e um pão de queijo'.

comprehension.question: How does the waiter say 'Enjoy your meal'?
comprehension.explanation: 'Bom apetite' is the standard phrase before eating.
